name: Loscil
label: Kranky
lede: Scott Morgan drummed for Destroyer, named his own project after a line of Csound code and sent a demo to Chicago. Kranky has been releasing the results since, long records about Vancouver's harbors, islands and weather.

eras.title: The drummer with a synthesis manual
eras.text: Scott Morgan grew up in Vancouver and Courtenay, studied under computer-music pioneer Barry Truax at Simon Fraser University, and played drums in Destroyer. On the side he started making ambient electronics inside a Vancouver multimedia collective.

years.h: Scott Morgan takes the drum stool in Destroyer
years.p: Morgan plays drums, saxophone, clarinet and classical guitar in [[Destroyer|61604b45-8a91-4e33-a1b6-45d7b1fec4e5]] from 1998 to 2002, alongside [[Dan Bejar|9f142b12-570e-464d-9cb0-f1d579bb6a66]].

years.h: Loscil starts at The Blinding Light, an underground cinema
years.p: Morgan launches the project while part of Multiplex, a collective running audiovisual nights at the Vancouver venue. The name comes from a function in Csound.
years.xp:
Csound is a sound synthesis programming language, and loscil is its instruction for playing a sampled sound in a loop. Wikipedia reads the name as "looping oscillator"; AllMusic reads it as loop plus oscillate.

Either way, it's a synthesis nerd's joke that became a career.

years.h: A demo named for a physics textbook reaches Chicago
years.p: A New Demonstration of Thermodynamic Tendencies, self-released by Morgan, is the first Loscil album and catches the ear of Kranky.

eras.title: Kranky takes the demo, Destroyer takes the drummer back
eras.text: Kranky turned the demo into a debut, and Morgan built each record around a concept, from thermodynamics to deep water. He still found time to rejoin Destroyer.

years.h: Kranky puts out Triple Point and Loscil has a label
years.p: AllMusic dates the release to October 2001 and describes it as Morgan's thermodynamics demo under a new title.
years.xp: The sources disagree on what Triple Point is. AllMusic says Kranky released the self-made demo as Loscil's official debut under the new title. Wikipedia lists the 1999 self-release and the 2001 Kranky album as two separate records.

years.h: Submers names its tracks after submarines
years.p: Morgan's second Kranky album is built on dub pulses and drones, and its theme is the deep.

years.h: Loscil runs under the documentary The Corporation
years.p: Morgan's music appears in the Canadian film, the first of many film and TV placements.

years.h: First Narrows adds live players
years.p: Named for the Vancouver harbor channel under the Lions Gate Bridge, Loscil's third album brings in live instruments. Wikipedia calls the tone poems more organic and looser than before.

years.h: Back in Destroyer, with a bonus track named for him
years.p: Morgan plays in [[Destroyer|61604b45-8a91-4e33-a1b6-45d7b1fec4e5]] again from 2005 to 2007. The vinyl of Destroyer's Rubies (2006) carries an extra track called Loscil's Rubies.

years.h: Fourth album, Plume, looks up
years.p: After the water of Submers, Morgan's concepts climb into the air.

eras.title: Games by day, Vancouver by night
eras.text: Morgan worked as a sound director in video games and made records about the city around him. Destroyer's Dan Bejar showed up on one, and film studios kept licensing the rest.

years.h: Morgan scores the hit indie game Osmos
years.p: The same year, Strathcona Variations, named for a Vancouver neighborhood, comes out on Ghostly International.
years.xp: MUTEK describes Morgan as a sound director in video games, and loscil.ca counts 10 years of game audio. The day job runs alongside the records, and the games keep coming: Prototype 2 in 2012 and Hundreds in 2013, per Wikipedia.

years.cap: Scott Morgan on stage as Loscil
years.h: Dan Bejar reads over Morgan's music on Endless Falls
years.p: The Kranky album closes with Destroyer's [[Dan Bejar|9f142b12-570e-464d-9cb0-f1d579bb6a66]] speaking over the music. Bejar's Archer on the Beach EP the same year carries a spoken piece, Grief Point, with music by Loscil.

years.h: Prototype 2 gets a Loscil score
years.p: The open-world action game is a long way from the cinema basements where Loscil began. Sketches from New Brighton comes out on Kranky the same year.

years.cap: Scott Morgan live at [F]luister 30, Dordrechts Museum, Netherlands, March 31, 2013
years.h: Sofia Coppola puts Loscil in The Bling Ring
years.p: Morgan's music lands in the heist film, then in Divergent a year later. He also makes Erebus with [[bvdub|94d43a2c-b5f5-4d02-988c-20332d1eebd3]] on Glacial Movements.

years.big: The nature is so beautiful but it's coupled with human intervention.
q: The nature is so beautiful but it's coupled with human intervention
years.h: Sea Island sets bird sanctuaries beside an airport
years.p: Morgan names the Kranky album after the Richmond, BC island that holds Vancouver's airport and its bird sanctuaries.
years.xp: Morgan told Exberliner that Vancouver was the ideal setting for his music, "in a sort of ironic way": the landscape is stunning, and it is never far from industry. That balance, he said, is what interests him.

eras.title: A generative app, a Budapest string section
eras.text: Morgan stretched Loscil into an app, a cello duo and Netflix work, then recorded with a 22-piece orchestra. Clara scored 85 on Metacritic.

years.cap: Loscil live at Cafe Oto, London
years.h: ADRIFT never plays the same way twice
years.p: It's an app, not a record: Morgan's music is generated fresh each time it plays.

years.h: Monument Builders counts the human footprint
years.p: Seven tracks with titles like Drained Lake, Red Tide and Anthropocene, released on Kranky.
years.xp: Somewherecold ranked Monument Builders number four on its list of the year's top 10 albums, according to Wikipedia.

years.cap: Scott Morgan at The Gatherings, St. Mary's Hamilton Village, Philadelphia
yt: Live, Ace Hotel Theater, Los Angeles, Jan 2017
years.h: Morgan and cellist Mark Bridges form High Plains
years.p: Their debut, Cinderland, is on Kranky. The same year Loscil scores Netflix's Suburra: Blood on Rome.

years.h: Stieglitz's cloud photographs become Equivalents
years.p: Morgan takes the name and the idea from Alfred Stieglitz's cloud series. It premieres at MUTEK as an audiovisual show with heavy sub-bass.

years.h: A 22-piece Budapest string orchestra becomes Clara
years.p: Morgan builds the Kranky album from recordings of the orchestra. It scores 85 on Metacritic, the site's category for universal acclaim.

eras.title: Colours of air, lake fire
eras.text: Loscil's recent run pairs Morgan with Australian sound artist Lawrence English and ends, so far, with a solo record named for fire on the water.

years.h: Eight years of dance collaborations become The Sails
years.p: Morgan self-releases a two-hour double album of music for choreographers.

years.h: Lawrence English and Morgan make Colours of Air
years.p: Morgan and Brisbane's [[Lawrence English|eadd64ca-a4f8-4c0c-8405-fa46a7be2380]] record the Kranky album together; AllMusic says it drew wide acclaim.

years.h: Four years after Clara, Lake Fire
years.p: Nine tracks on Kranky, from Arrhythmia to Ash Clouds to the title piece.
